hannah_pm: Quick sync 1: define v1 install/upgrade acceptance for private deployments. key items: egress IP persistence, offline installer, and rollback steps.

omar_eng: agree. propose MUSTs: static-egress toggle, installer tarball + checksums, and automated KV snapshot before upgrades.

rachel_field: Field requests: clear installer preflight messages, one-click rollback guidance, and an opt-in auto-upgrade flag. customers want console banner for pending upgrades.

diego_sre: For rollback: create a verified snapshot procedure and a fast revert path <20m. runbook should include commands and post-rollback validation probes.

omar_eng: Implementation note: we'll add `egress.mode=static` and `egress.lbIP` to CRD. offline bundle = images.tar + manifests + sha256. preflight will list failures and a single remediation line.

infra-bot: TICKET CREATED: RW-PRIV-902 "install flow: static egress + offline installer + rollback" assigned to private-packaging.

hannah_pm: Owners/timebox: omar = config + proto by Wed; diego = rollback runbook by Fri; rachel = beta customers and comms. aim to validate with 2 betas for 2 weeks before GA.

rachel_field: I'll line up customers next week. one more ask: include an offline snapshot export/import for airgapped sites.

hannah_pm: Added. final checklist for v1: 1) static-egress + doc, 2) offline installer bundle, 3) preflight checks, 4) automated snapshot + rollback playbook, 5) two beta validations. Thanks all.
